title: Bespoke Consultation & Silhouette
tagline: Translating your wedding vision into silken reality
description: We discuss your saree color palette, jewelry style, event lighting, and preferred neckline. You can share your mood board, Pinterest saves, or sketch ideas with our lead designer.
artisanDetail: Personalized color swatching and neck-depth ergonomics tailored for heavy bridal jewelry.

title: Khaka Blueprint & Motif Drafting
tagline: The sacred geometry of royal embroidery
description: Our master draftsman hand-sketches the 'Khaka' on tracing parchment to your exact bodily measurements. Every peacock feather, lotus petal, and border curve is calibrated to millimeter precision.
artisanDetail: Pin-pricked stencil with herbal chalk powder transfer onto the stretched fabric.

title: Adda Mounting & Aari Stitching
tagline: Rhythmic hooked-needle symphony by master karigars
description: The pure raw silk is tensioned over a traditional wooden 'Adda' frame. Using the hooked Aari needle (muthia), artisans meticulously loop pure metallic zari, sequins, dabka wire, and seed pearls.
artisanDetail: Over 40,000 individual chain loops crafted purely by hand without any automated machinery.

title: Couture Lining, Padding & Finishing
description: Heavy embroidery requires structured tailoring. We line the blouse with breathable, skin-friendly cotton voile, integrate seamless imported boning/cups, and finish with hand-sewn dori latkans.
artisanDetail: Triple-stitched reinforced stress points so you move, sit, and dance with effortless grace.

title: Heirloom Packaging & Global Dispatch
description: Each finished ensemble undergoes 18-point quality inspection. It is swaddled in acid-free tissue paper, tucked into a signature gold-embossed keepsake box, and shipped via tracked express courier worldwide.
artisanDetail: Includes complimentary zari preservation kit, moisture-absorbing silica, and fabric care guidelines.
